AutoSwitch.Name: Follow the turn order
AutoSwitch.Hint: When the turn changes, switch to the sheet of the current combatant. Only combatants with a tab count, so player turns leave the window alone unless player characters are included below.

IncludePCs.Name: Include player characters
IncludePCs.Hint: Give player-owned combatants a tab as well. Off by default: the browser is meant for the NPCs you run.

ClickAway.Name: Minimize on canvas clicks
ClickAway.Hint: Clicking into the scene folds the open sheet back into the tab row. Clicks on dialogs, the sidebar and other windows leave it alone.

AutoCloseDefeated.Name: Close defeated combatants
AutoCloseDefeated.Hint: When a combatant is marked defeated, close its sheet automatically. Its tab stays greyed out either way.

SyncSize.Name: Match window size across tabs
SyncSize.Hint: On: the browser acts like one fixed window. Resize any sheet and every tab you switch to opens at that exact size and position. Off: each sheet keeps its own size, so the window grows or shrinks depending on which tab is open. The Sheet size slider zooms the content either way.

SheetScale.Name: Sheet size
SheetScale.Hint: Zooms actor sheets, everything inside included. 100% is normal size.

ScaleOutside.Name: Scale sheets outside combat
ScaleOutside.Hint: Apply the sheet size slider to every actor sheet you open, not just the combat browser's. Turning it off returns open non-combat sheets to normal size.
